title: The Lighthouse That Answered
logline: Nell rows across a frozen sea to a lighthouse dark for forty years, and discovers what her missing mother has been doing there all along.
hook: For forty years, the lighthouse at Harrow Point has been dark. Last night, it blinked.
place: an abandoned lighthouse on a frozen sea

character.name: Nell Harrow
character.appearance: young woman in her twenties, short dark hair, determined eyes, carrying an old brass lantern
character.clothing: red hooded oilskin coat, dark boots
character.style: cinematic photo, moody, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field

scenes.narration: For forty years, the lighthouse at Harrow Point has been dark. Last night, it blinked.
scenes.visual: enormous dark lighthouse on a frozen sea at dusk, a single faint red light flickering in thick fog, no people

scenes.narration: Nell rowed out across the ice alone, because the light was blinking in her mother's code.
scenes.visual: small figure in a red hooded coat dragging a boat across cracked ice toward the distant lighthouse, holding a brass lantern, wide shot

scenes.narration: Inside, every step upward matched a name carved into the wall. Hers was waiting at the top.
scenes.visual: narrow spiral stone staircase inside a lighthouse, hundreds of names carved into the walls, warm lantern glow, a woman in a red coat climbing

scenes.narration: In the lamp room, the ancient lens turned by itself, and the fog began to pull back.
scenes.visual: giant glowing fresnel lens in a lighthouse lamp room, golden beams cutting through fog, woman in red coat silhouetted, awe

scenes.narration: Beneath the ice, thousands of lights blinked awake. Ships, lost for decades, waiting to be seen.
scenes.visual: aerial view of a frozen sea at night, thousands of glowing ship lanterns visible beneath the ice, a lighthouse beam sweeping across, magical, epic scale

scenes.narration: Her mother never vanished. She kept the light burning, so the lost could find their way home.
scenes.visual: woman in red coat standing in lamp room, a warm golden ghostly figure of an older woman resting a hand on her shoulder, tears, emotional, soft light

scenes.narration: Now Nell lights it every night. And every night, someone comes home.
scenes.visual: lighthouse beaming warm light at sunrise across calm water, old wooden ships emerging from the mist toward harbor, hopeful, wide cinematic shot
